from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,tarfile
r=Path('/home/jay/build/wj-h13-fullheight-paired-domain-20261113')
m=json.loads((r/'wj-h13-observer-v5.json').read_text())
out=r/'observer-v5';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
with tarfile.open(r/'wj-h13-observer-v5.tar.gz')as t:
    assert set(t.getnames())=={v['path']for v in m['files']}
    for v in m['files']:
        b=t.extractfile(v['path']).read()
        assert len(b)==v['bytes']and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==v['sha256']
        (out/v['path']).write_bytes(b)
print('three committed overlay files hash verified',m['commit'])
print((r/'accounting.json').read_text())
